Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: v1.2.1 — Improvements and Fixes!
notes.content:
We've been immersed in development for some time, but the store has always remained in our thoughts! Presenting update v1.2.1 — compact, but packed with numerous important improvements and fixes for a more pleasant store management experience.

Visual Improvements

 Added head bobbing while walking — movement now looks more natural
 Added inertia to objects in hands — they now realistically sway when moving
 Both features can be configured in the settings menu

Assistant Improvements

 Assistant motivation now works on button hold, not press
 Pressing on an assistant now sends them to temporary rest or returns them to work
 Removed possibility of accidental interaction with assistant if you have something in your hands
 Stock handlers became smarter and can now switch between tasks faster without walking to shelves if you asked them to change work or go rest

Other Improvements and Fixes

 Fixed self-service operator work with multiple self-service checkouts
 Added display of money that will be returned when selling equipment
 Added ability to transfer goods from box to box directly
 Added keg fill indicator with color coding
 Added display of information about the product you're holding in your hands
 Fixed a bug that allowed earning excessive profit from draft beer
 Added display of update notes directly in the game's main menu


Thank you for staying with us! We carefully read your comments and continue working on improving the game.

notes.title: v1.2.0f2
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued feedback! We've released a new patch with various fixes and improvements:

 Cashier and self-checkout operator now work slower at high fatigue instead of making errors
 Cashier and self-checkout operator now only make errors at critical fatigue
 Fixed an error where assistants moved at old speed instead of updated speed
 Fixed incorrect display of loan data after loading when loan term differs from 15 days
 Fixed shopping cart interaction with boxes in warehouse after loading a save
 Fixed saving of boxes with expired orders under certain conditions
 Added our logo when starting the game

We continue working on game stability and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: v1.2.0f1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who shared feedback about the new fatigue system!

We quickly responded to your comments and released a hotfix:

 Added a fatigue mechanic toggle in settings — now it can be disabled
 Simplified the fatigue mechanic itself for a more comfortable gameplay experience
 Fixed an error that prevented placing decor on one of the walls

We want the game to be enjoyable, not feel like a second job.

Thank you for your feedback and patience!

notes.title: v1.2.0 - A Revolution in Store Management!
notes.content:
Remember when we said we'd focus on developing the assistant system? We kept our promise! Meet the most massive update that will fundamentally change how you manage your store. And for those who haven't joined our community yet — 30% off!

Assistant System Improvements
Added a new upgrade that allows you to hire up to 6 assistants instead of 3 and assign them to work behind the bar — finally, you'll have beer specialists! But be careful: we added a fatigue system, so your employees now get tired and need rest. However, as compensation, we increased their base speed — they became a bit quicker!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/9dad399b4e733f33c57c52096ffd67351310da03.gif"]

Meet your new... neighbor
A rather colorful character has settled near your store who will gladly accept any unwanted goods and boxes. He's quite talkative and changes his mood from time to time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/0765fff4dd667262d25cdd60fe5be4f77ae26fca.gif"]

Decor for your store
Added various decorative objects that will help give your store a unique style and atmosphere. No more boring cookie-cutter retail spaces — create a space to your taste!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/82c80e290749bdd2419c8f4c3f64d08a9b992b01.png"]

Other changes

 Increased warehouse size
 Rebalanced the cost of most upgrades — now they're much more affordable and won't require you to sell a kidney

Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug where warehouse item count didn't change when taking products for delivery directly from boxes
 Fixed duplication of delivery boxes when reloading a save without exiting the game
 Fixed duplication of draft beer bottles when reloading a save without exiting the game

This update will transform your humble little shop into a true retail empire with a professional team.

Thank you for your support and feedback! Join our Discord server — there you can chat with developers and other players, and if you encounter problems, easily attach screenshots or videos for quick resolution. Your feedback helps us make the game better!

notes.title: v1.1.1 - Bug Fixes and Updated Plans!
notes.content:
After the delivery update launch, we didn't sit idle and fixed several annoying bugs you reported to us. And since we're talking about delivery — we have great news for delivering our game to new players: 25% off until July 10th! We also tweaked our plans a bit — but more on that later.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed button icon display on Xbox-layout controllers
 Stock handler now properly responds when the player takes the last available warehouse spot while the handler is carrying a box
 Fixed picking up the last item from a shelf into delivery boxes
 Fixed saving and loading order of boxes on warehouse shelves
 Added current next update tasks to the main menu

By the way, hunting down some bugs turns us into real detectives — we have to piece together clues from content creator videos and scattered messages. To make it easier for us to help you (and ourselves), try to describe problems in detail: what happened, under what circumstances, what you were doing beforehand. The more information, the faster the fix! And yes, we're working on something that will streamline this whole process.

Small Change in Plans
We decided to adjust our roadmap slightly because our assistants demand more attention than we thought. Instead of draft beer improvements in the second phase, we'll focus on developing the assistant system: adding a specialized beer assistant, fatigue system, and the ability to hire more employees. Draft beer improvements will come later, but you'll have an excellent team to handle it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/e3cfd2a631db633396612de0aa7dc730fd9f84c7.png

Thanks for your feedback — it helps us prioritize correctly!

notes.title: v1.1.0 - Delivery Service and Much More!
notes.content:
Dear store owners!

We've been quiet for a while — we were hard at work on the new product delivery system and many other improvements. Now we're ready to present update 1.1.0! The main feature is the product delivery system, which will help you earn additional income and rating during downtime between serving customers. Additionally, we've added several improvements that will make the gameplay even more comfortable and realistic.

Oh, and we almost forgot — you can now take your store with you anywhere! The game is officially Steam Deck verified, having passed all compatibility tests successfully.

New Features:

 Added product delivery system — accept orders through the computer and deliver them yourself
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/01ca0eba0c98729dd375a3738d130d052c180970.png"]
 You can now change prices directly from price tags
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/1d00783581b9bec369a295611a6b5f33f31dd130.png"]
 New sounds and customer phrases for various situations
 Shelves now highlight in yellow when placing items or boxes would replace the price tag or label
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/12f04c57f27b240382b1fb865d8ec152fc18ef04.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/749246d93f876bfea24f491b953b0cd61b9c5741.gif"]

Improvements and Optimization:

 Enhanced and improved tutorial for better understanding of game mechanics
 Improved object placement system near walls
 Stock handlers now properly respond to price tag removal during restocking

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed achievement unlocking for 100 services and 100 correct ID checks
 Fixed issues with warehouse shelf interaction after stock handlers place boxes

Thank you for your support and patience! This update was made possible thanks to your feedback and suggestions. Keep sharing your thoughts — we carefully read every message, even if we don't always respond!

notes.title: v1.0.4 - Gamepad Support!
notes.content:
Dear store owners!

We're happy to announce that the long-awaited gamepad support is finally available! Now you can choose your preferred control method — keyboard and mouse or gamepad. Additionally, we've improved the box shelves, making interaction with them a bit more comfortable.

About Music and Copyright
We continue working on protecting content creators from false copyright claims. We've removed the "Soft Romantic Piano" track from Streamer Mode, as it was sometimes causing issues as well.

If you're creating content and facing copyright claims for music from the game, please let us know. We strive to promptly add problematic tracks to the Streamer Mode exclusion list to keep your streams and videos restriction-free.

Thank you for your patience and support! New improvements are already in the works, so stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Improved Logistics and Fixes!
notes.content:
Dear store owners!

While our assistants are finally getting the hang of doorways, we've focused on improving other aspects of your business. We've made significant improvements to warehouse logistics – your stock handlers will now move boxes with purpose rather than randomly! We've also upgraded shopping baskets to give you better control over which items to place where. Small improvements, big difference!

Warehouse System Improvements:

 Stock handlers now prioritize emptier shelves (apparently your hints finally got through)
 Stock handlers now attempt to coordinate which items they're moving to avoid duplicating efforts
 Lowered shelf positions on warehouse racks for easier access

Store Operations Improvements:

 Use mouse wheel to select which basket item to place on empty shelves
 Limited basket variety to 12 different product types (total capacity remains 40 items)

Fixes and Other Improvements:

 Character can finally crouch
 Tags on empty shelves now save correctly
 Fixed box pickup order after loading saves (no more levitating boxes!)
 Fixed aspect ratios on some desktop wallpapers in the computer
 Fixed floor material saving (apologies, but the bank refuses to reimburse expenses, citing their "corporate policy")

Music & Copyright Notice
We discovered that "The Groove" triggers copyright claims for content creators, despite having a license that should allow free use. We've excluded this track from Streamer Mode to prevent strikes, while regular players can still enjoy the music.

If you're creating content and experiencing similar issues, please let us know which specific tracks are triggering copyright claims. We'll promptly add them to the Streamer Mode exclusion list!

What's Coming Next?
We're hard at work on complete controller support and plan to finish it soon. You'll be able to manage your store from the comfort of your couch with a gamepad in hand!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Don't hesitate to share any issues you encounter in the discussions – you never know, your issue might be fixed in the very next update!

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Assistants have learned how to use doorways!
notes.content:
Dear store owners!

We're excited to announce our assistants have finally completed the basic course "How Not to Get Stuck in Doorways"! No more strange attempts to squeeze through door frames or walk through display windows instead of doors. These goofballs have finally mastered obstacle navigation and can now proudly move between rooms without making you want to quit the game.

Besides re-educating our hapless assistants, update 1.0.2 includes the following improvements:


 Welcome a new employee! Your store now has a female assistant who might bring some common sense to the team
 Equipped warehouse shelves with tags that display the total quantity of goods in boxes on the shelf
 Assistants have become smarter at arranging boxes in the warehouse: they now prioritize shelves with tags before looking for any empty space
 Made shopping baskets smarter: they can now interact with boxes on shelves and place exactly the product indicated on the price tag (if one exists)
 Added a 21+ sticker to cash register screens
 Enhanced the computer desktop with new stylish wallpapers
 Fixed a bug that allowed changing product prices during a customer's shelf viewing animation, causing them to pay the modified price
 Fixed Shift key behavior when editing text fields on the computer - now everything works as intended


Thanks for your feedback and bug reports — they help us make the game better! Keep sharing any issues or wishes you encounter.

By the way, if you notice our poor fellows studying wall geometry again — let us know. They might need to take an additional course in spatial orientation!

notes.title: 🍷 Liquor Store Simulator – Roadmap Reveal! 🛒
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re thrilled to finally share with you the official Roadmap for Liquor Store Simulator! 🚀 Your feedback and support have been driving this project forward, and now it’s time to show you what’s coming next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185527/f740cf57768cb2bc004131fbdf317339b8af198c.png

🔧 Development is planned in three major update stages – each packed with features, improvements, and content based on what you have been asking for. You can check out the full breakdown on the graphic above 👆

Here's a quick glimpse of what to expect:

🛠️ Stage 1:

 Update the tutorial system
 Fresh sounds and new NPC
 Mini-tasks to spice up your routine
 Ability to change prices directly from price tags
 Alcohol delivery feature

🧊 Stage 2:

 Draft beer refrigerator
 Snacks next to the beer (realism matters!)
 Store decorations
 …and something we’re calling “The Pet” 🐾 (you’ll see 😉)

🏪 Stage 3:

 Cleaning mechanics
 New products and equipment
 Assistants to help manage the store
 Assistant fatigue (because even NPCs need breaks!)



Now, about when these updates will land…

We know it’s common to set specific dates for each patch, but we want to focus on quality and polish, not rushing features out the door. That’s why we’re not committing to fixed deadlines — instead, we promise to release each stage as soon as it’s truly ready, with care and your feedback in mind.

So stay with us, follow the journey, and don’t be shy about sharing your thoughts — this store is just getting started, and we’re building it together. 💬🧃

Thanks for being part of the Liquor Store Simulator community! ❤️

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Critical Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you so much for the warm reception of the game and for sharing your feedback and suggestions.

We've released our first update, which fixes a critical bug and introduces several quality of life improvements:


 Fixed an issue with loading certain save files
 Added autosave at the end of each game day
 Added ability to remove price tags from empty shelves
 Normalized volume levels across all music tracks
 Fixed automatic music playback on first game launch
 Resolved an issue with entering prices after changing language settings during gameplay


Thank you for your support and feedback! Please continue sharing your thoughts - it helps us make the game better.
